mapper.sql: id, order_number, user_id, status, pay_status, pay_method, total_amount, discount_amount, freight_amount, pay_amount, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_province, receiver_city, receiver_district, receiver_area_code, receiver_detail, remark, submit_token, cancel_reason, cancel_time, pay_time, delivery_time, receive_time, expire_time, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: insert into mall_order (order_number, user_id, status, pay_status, pay_method, total_amount, discount_amount, freight_amount, pay_amount, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_province, receiver_city, receiver_district, receiver_area_code, receiver_detail, remark, submit_token, expire_time, create_time, update_time) values (#{orderNumber}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{payStatus}, #{payMethod}, #{totalAmount}, #{discountAmount}, #{freightAmount}, #{payAmount}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{receiverProvince}, #{receiverCity}, #{receiverDistrict}, #{receiverAreaCode}, #{receiverDetail}, #{remark}, #{submitToken}, #{expireTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select count(*) from mall_order where user_id = #{userId} and submit_token = #{token}
mapper.update: update mall_order set status = 'CANCELLED', cancel_reason = #{reason}, cancel_time = #{now}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT'

update mall_order set status = 'PENDING_DELIVERY', pay_status = 'PAID', pay_time = #{payTime}, pay_method = #{payMethod}, update_time = now() where order_number = #{orderNumber} and status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT'
mapper.select: select from mall_order where status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' and expire_time is not null and expire_time < #{deadline} order by id asc
select count(*) from mall_order where status = #{status}
